acip: GNYIS PA DE NYID RAB DBYE'I SGO NAS RGYAS PAR BSHAD PA LA LNGA, PHYI DANG, NANG DANG, GSANG BA, DE KHO NA NYID KYI MCHOD PA, SMAN DANG LUS 'BUL BA'O,,
wylie: gnyis pa de nyid rab dbye'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa la lnga, phyi dang, nang dang, gsang ba, de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa, sman dang lus 'bul ba'o
english: This brings us to our second point: a more expanded explanation of the different types of offering.  We proceed through five subjects--the outer offering, the inner offering, the secret offering, the offering of suchness, and the offering of both the elixir and our own body.
